item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud glu ru'i thugs bcud las nyams khrid 'phrul mdzod zhus lan dang po lo rgyus g.yung drung nyi 'od gsal sgron
item.coloph: ces slob dpon thugs kyi sgrab pa yi/ nyams khrid 'phrul gyis (gyi) lde mig brgyud/ lo rgyus g.yung drung nyi 'od sgron/ ma 'ongs dus kyi snyigs ma la/ go bo 'phags btsun pad+ma rje/ nub phyogs o rgyan pho brang nas/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bdag nyid kyis (kyi/)yum chen thugs rje kun grol mas/ zhal 'jal (mjal) gsang ba'i dngos grub gnang*/ ma 'ongs 'gro la phan phyir du/ skal ldan grogs pos bskul ngor du/ zab mo'i yi ger gtan la phab/ 'gro rnams smin grol don ldan shog ces zab mo gsal ba'i lo rgyus g.yung drung nyi 'od gsal ba'i sgron ma le'u ste dang po'o/ rig 'dzin chen po byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyis snyan du rgyud pa'o//
